limits: Exact native trollCaveA / enTroll01 / renderer 121153 source assignment only; sibling troll rows, renderer sources, and the separate Gloamcap resource-prefab route do not receive credit.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced the same target from 58 HP to 48 HP; death used the separate explicit KillSingle fixture at 48 HP and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Twenty-eight selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 332 retained capture frames and generated videos are preserved evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The fixture death completed all 120 requested frames through deathHeavy_troll with m_DoRagdoll true; 11 surviving native rigidbodies become nonkinematic from retained frame 28. The physical corpse is visible through retained frame 119, and no later lifetime is claimed.

The exact renderer stayed active, enabled, visible, and identity-stable in all 360 retained frames; native combat UI, bright effects, foreground hero overlap, loot overlay, depth blur, and camera motion limit fine inspection.
One guarded native Collect action reached strict Ready at level 0 room 2; broader campaign progression was not exercised.
The native Standard material retains emission keyword state, white emission color, and trollCave_e, so the pale authored base color appears warmer in game than its source texture.

Intentional gaps between authored rock masses remain a scoped prototype-art limitation; no sampled tearing, renderer loss, viewport-edge clipping, floor fall-through, or unintended animated-section detachment was observed.

Other troll controller clips and proficiencies, sibling sources, portraits, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime, full campaign completion, and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
